name: Settlement Terms 3
definition: Specifies the beneficiary's account information for the settlement of a purchase of goods or services.

CreditorAgent.name: Creditor Agent
CreditorAgent.definition: Financial institution that receives the payment transaction on behalf of an account owner, and posts the transaction into the account.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Account to be credited as a result of an instruction.
